children: Singapore’s GDP growth outlook for the rest of 2026 remains firm, a trade ministry official said on Tuesday.

Strong momentum in global AI investment is set to continue for the rest of the year, though the pace of growth in new AI investment is set to moderate from a high in 2026, said Ministry of Energy, Trade and Industry permanent secretary Beh Swan Gin.
